composite_candidates.name: send_with_thread_followup
composite_candidates.rationale: Post a parent message and immediately add a threaded follow-up reply — common pattern for context-rich announcements. Sub-op 1 is non-rollbackable (a posted message cannot be unposted atomically); use partial_failure_strategy='report'.

tool_plans.name: messages_search
tool_plans.rationale: Search messages and channels and users by free-text query and return ranked smart IDs.

tool_plans.name: objects_fetch
tool_plans.rationale: Retrieve a single Channel, User, or Message by smart ID.

tool_plans.name: collections_list
tool_plans.rationale: Discover top-level collections (Channels) for the workspace.

tool_plans.name: objects_list
tool_plans.rationale: List Messages within a Channel with cursor pagination (response_metadata.next_cursor).

tool_plans.name: objects_upsert
tool_plans.rationale: Create a new Message (chat.postMessage) or update an existing one (chat.update).

tool_plans.name: objects_delete
tool_plans.rationale: Delete a Message (chat.delete). Channels are archived, not deleted (use channels_archive).

tool_plans.name: messages_send
tool_plans.rationale: Send a Message (medium-confidence _send pattern; not idempotent — resending creates a duplicate). Distinct semantics from upsert because it is the canonical user intent.

tool_plans.name: messages_edit
tool_plans.rationale: Edit an existing Message (idempotent — re-applying same edit is a no-op per Slack semantics).

tool_plans.name: channels_archive
tool_plans.rationale: Archive a Channel (destructive+idempotent per _archive Appendix B verb pattern; Slack's canonical 'remove channel' since channels cannot be hard-deleted).

tool_plans.name: send_with_thread_followup
tool_plans.rationale: Multi-step workflow: post parent message, then post threaded reply. Conservative aggregation: !destructive, !idempotent (sub-op 1 dominates), partial_failure_strategy='report' (cannot atomically rollback a posted parent message).
